preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be even and between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist of exactly n lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(1 <= b_i <= 100 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: The beauty values b must be a list of n integers, each between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible beauty of the antipalindromic permutation t.
